section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedure for a study conducted in Iran involving university students from seven large universities in Tehran. Data were collected between December 2014 and June 2015 using paper-and-pencil surveys, with the BAS-2 scale used to assess body appreciation. The study involved translation and back-translation of the BAS-2 into Persian, and participants completed questionnaires anonymously in classroom settings on a voluntary basis.
